content.value: A rectangular plate is bounded $0 < x < \alpha , 0 < y < b$ . The sides of the plate $u ( 0 , y )$ , 17 $u ( a , y ) , u ( x , b )$ are kept at zero degree temperature. The temperature of the side $\begin{array} { r } { u ( x , 0 ) = \mathrm { s i n } \frac { n \pi x } { \alpha } } \end{array}$ . Determine the temperature at any point of the plate in the steady-state.
